articles.title: Adani Energy Wins 25-Year Bengal Deal for 1,750 MW of Round-the-Clock Renewable Power
articles.excerpt: The Letter of Award from WBSEDCL covers 1,750 MW from July 2028, with a 750 MW option that would take the total to 2,500 MW if exercised. No tariff or contract value was disclosed.
articles.image_caption: Archival photograph: Gautam Adani (right) at an event in West Bengal in September 2026. Adani Energy Solutions said its subsidiary has won a 25-year award to supply 1,750 MW of round-the-clock renewable power to the state discom.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors tracking Adani group stocks, the investable facts are the awarded 1,750 MW and 2028 start — the 2,500 MW headline includes an unexercised option, and no tariff was disclosed.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street's AI Selloff Deepens as S&P 500 and Dow Confirm Correction
articles.excerpt: The Nasdaq fell 5.28% on Friday and erased its 2026 gains as Anthropic's debut fizzled and Nvidia slid 13.8%, pushing the S&P 500 and the Dow more than 10% below their record closes.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rupee Closes Above 93 for First Time in Seven Months, at 92.67 to the Dollar
articles.excerpt: A fifth straight session of gains, powered by ₹84,290 crore of foreign equity inflows in nine November sessions and weaker crude, took the rupee past a level it last closed above on April 10.
articles.image_caption: A graphic shows the US dollar and Indian rupee symbols side by side.
articles.nri_angle: A rupee at 92.67 means each dollar remitted to India converts to fewer rupees than a week ago, while a sustained rally would ease India's import bill.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Walmart Earnings Beat Estimates as Revenue Rises 5.2% to $188.8 Billion, Guidance Raised
articles.excerpt: Adjusted earnings of $0.65 a share topped expectations as U.S. online sales grew 23%, even as an investment swing cut reported profit and Flipkart's sale timing weighed on international results.
articles.image_caption: A Walmart store exterior. Walmart reported fiscal third-quarter revenue of $188.8 billion, up 5.2%, and raised its guidance.

sources.label: Zacks — WMT Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Strong Digital Sales Lift Outlook
Morningstar / Dow Jones — Walmart Raises Fiscal Year Guidance Amid 3Q Earnings Beat

articles.nri_angle: Walmart's India business through Flipkart is central to its international results; the Big Billion Days timing shift weighed on Q3 international eCommerce and advertising and is expected to benefit Q4.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: South Korea Passes $1 Trillion in Exports, Fourth Country Ever, on AI Chip Boom
articles.excerpt: A one-year leap from last year's $709 billion record, powered by Samsung and SK hynix memory sales into the AI data-centre build-out.
articles.nri_angle: Korea's chip-led surge is the supply side of the AI boom that diaspora tech workers and investors are riding from the demand side in the US.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 24 VC Firms Commit ₹1,050 Crore to Deeptech Startups at Bengaluru Tech Summit
articles.excerpt: Commitments announced at the Future Makers Conclave are 2.6 times last year's ₹400 crore, aimed at aerospace, defence, AI, robotics and semiconductor startups — with no disbursement schedule yet shared.
articles.image_caption: Exhibition stalls and visitors at the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026, held at the Bengaluru International Exhibition Centre. Twenty-four venture capital firms announced ₹1,050.42 crore in deeptech investment commitments at the summit's Future Makers Conclave.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors and founders track India's deeptech funding rounds closely; the test of this announcement is how much of the ₹1,050 crore is actually disbursed, and to whom.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fed Minutes Show Officials Flagging AI Boom and High Valuations as Stability Risks
articles.excerpt: Policymakers at the October 27-28 meeting named elevated valuations, hedge fund leverage and opaque AI financing among the system's biggest vulnerabilities, even as staff called the system resilient.
articles.nri_angle: US rate and stability signals drive the portfolios, mortgages and remittance timing of Indian households in the US; the December 8-9 meeting is the next marker.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: Fed meeting held (Oct 27-28); rates maintained at 3.75%-4.00%

articles.title: Rupee Hits Seven-Month High Near ₹93.40, Squeezing IT Exporters' Earnings
articles.excerpt: The rupee's rise to about ₹93.39–₹93.41 per dollar, powered by foreign inflows and cheaper oil, cuts the rupee value of TCS and Infosys's dollar earnings — and the Nifty IT index has fallen over 5.5% this month.
articles.image_caption: A graphic balances the US dollar against the Indian rupee. The rupee rose to a seven-month high of about ₹93.40 per dollar on November 18, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: A stronger rupee trims what dollar remittances buy in India and reshapes the reported earnings of the IT firms many diaspora investors and employees are tied to.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

rows: Net profit growth, in US dollars

articles.title: Goldman Sachs Upgrades India to Overweight, Sets End-2027 Nifty Target of 28,500
articles.excerpt: The bank expects 15 percent earnings growth in each of the next two years and calls India an AI diversifier after an unprecedented 83-percentage-point underperformance against the region.
articles.image_caption: A Goldman Sachs sign at the bank's offices.
articles.nri_angle: Goldman's overweight call favours domestic cyclicals over export-heavy IT names, the sector mix that dominates many NRI India portfolios.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Target Earnings Beat Estimates as Sales Rise 7.1% and Guidance Rises
articles.excerpt: Target earned $2.65 a share on $27.07 billion in sales, beating the Zacks consensus on both lines as comparable sales rose 5.6% on 5% traffic growth — and raised its full-year sales and earnings guidance ahead of the holidays.

sources.label: Target Corporation — Q3 2026 Earnings Release (PR Newswire)
Zacks — Target Q3 Earnings Beat on Sales Growth and Tariff Refunds, FY26 View Up

articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India On Track to Hit $1 Trillion in Exports This Year, Commerce Secretary Says
articles.excerpt: Rajesh Agrawal's assessment at a FICCI session rests on record October data — $89.99 billion in total exports and a record $49.47 billion in goods — against last fiscal's all-time high of $863 billion.
articles.nri_angle: Exports to the United States grew 39% in October, and the $1 trillion pace is a data point diaspora investors and India-linked businesses are pricing into 2027 plans.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Walt Disney Beats Estimates as Q4 Revenue Rises 16% to $25.9 Billion and Adjusted EPS Hits $1.77
articles.excerpt: Streaming profit more than doubled, parks posted record results and ESPN rode record NFL viewership as Disney beat estimates, raised its dividend 33% and guided to double-digit earnings growth in fiscal 2027.
articles.image_caption: The Walt Disney Studios headquarters in Burbank, California. Disney beat Wall Street estimates in fiscal Q4 2026, with revenue up 16% to $25.9 billion.

articles.title: Sensex Rallies 427 Points to 82,532 as Bank Stocks Power Second Straight Gain
articles.excerpt: The Nifty closed at 25,387, its highest in nine months, as the Nifty Bank index hit a record 62,442 and foreign investors kept buying despite a weak global trend.
articles.nri_angle: Indian benchmarks rose for a second day on foreign inflows even as US and Asian markets fell, and the rupee strengthened to 93.47 per dollar — the backdrop for NRI portfolio and remittance decisions this week.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Yes Bank and RBI Ask Supreme Court to Review Verdict Restoring Rs 8,415 Crore of AT1 Bonds
articles.excerpt: Both the bank and the regulator filed review petitions on November 13 against the October 15 judgment that quashed the 2020 AT1 write-down, while bondholders pursue contempt proceedings to force restoration.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors were among the retail and institutional holders of Indian bank AT1 bonds, whose loss-absorption terms this case is defining.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dow Falls 739 Points as Nvidia-Led AI Sell-Off Deepens Before Earnings
articles.excerpt: The Nasdaq lost 2.5% and the S&P 500 1.9% on Monday as Nvidia fell for a third straight day after Jensen Huang's resignation, and a new chip-export rule tightened the pressure on AI stocks.
articles.image_caption: Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California (file photo)
articles.nri_angle: AI and chip stocks are core holdings in many Indian-American retirement and brokerage portfolios, and Nvidia's earnings on Tuesday will set the tone for the sector those portfolios track.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian IT Firms Hold Cash Collection Steady as Clients Slow New Deals
articles.excerpt: Average days sales outstanding improved marginally to about 75 days, even as cautious client spending lengthens the road from deal approval to revenue.
articles.nri_angle: Many diaspora portfolios and jobs sit inside these firms; stable collections mean the sector's strain is showing up in new-deal timing, not in unpaid bills.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jefferies Keeps Buy Ratings on Six Adani Stocks, Backs $51 Billion Capex Plan
articles.excerpt: The brokerage reaffirmed Buys across the Adani Group, set target prices for all six names, and projected 23% compound EBITDA and EPS growth through FY29 — while flagging leverage and execution risk.
articles.image_caption: The Adani logo on a group office building.
articles.nri_angle: Adani names are widely held in NRI portfolios; Jefferies' targets and its own leverage warnings frame both sides of the position.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Foreign Investors Pump $7.5 Billion Into Indian Equities in Ten Sessions
articles.excerpt: The November inflow is the highest monthly figure in five years on Bloomberg data, reversing a year of heavy FPI selling — while domestic institutions book profits into a near-10% rally.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai. Foreign portfolio investors bought Indian equities at a five-year-high pace in early November.
articles.nri_angle: Foreign flows into Indian equities move the Sensex, the Nifty and the rupee — the benchmarks diaspora investors track for their India portfolios and remittance timing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
